body.text:
There are many cases (for example, if using a tool that generates
changelogs from git history) where a full clone is desired, but until
now you had to specify a clone depth large enough to ensure you get
everything. ~~This is a shortcut for that, translating a negative clone
depth to the git magic number for infinite depth of `math.MaxInt32`.~~
This PR now allows `depth` to be `full` (case- and whitespace- insensitive)

Omitted from the commit message accidentally, I also changed the
type of the `depth` key to `int32` everywhere, since it is the largest
value that `git` allows.

Signed-off-by: Josh Ghiloni <redacted@example.invalid>

title.text: spindle: allow full clone without guessing the depth
